answer: Ask what a clone farm cannot buy in bulk, and the answer points at Screened audiologist registration with hearing care council attestation. It requires a registration the council renews after fitting audits, so the meadow of scaling up is a queue of real-world chores. A farm doing the maths finds the thread first: a hundred clones need a hundred proofs, and the epoch reward divided a hundred ways is already less than the cost of one. The basalt is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
